sources: Competitor audit 11/11/2026, content plan study 11/11/2026, inspo visual 11/11/2026, content style reference 02/11/2026, Merlin's Instagram read 17/11/2026, shop closures from Lily 17/11/2026

borrow.use: Lamb shank tease and process posts.

borrow.idea: Dish name plus components as the whole caption, one cosy mood line, no hard sell (1,338 likes on a pork chop reel).
borrow.use: Cooler weather mood posts for stews.

borrow.idea: A title card in the dish colour, then silence. Recipe highlights in the caption.
borrow.use: Name the dish posts for new items.

borrow.idea: A repeatable named series, so people know what the next one is (Trashy to Classy).
borrow.use: Hour by hour and Worth the wait as named series.

borrow.idea: Sharing post (228 likes, best of its latest 6) and a game post once a month. Footer repeats price and add on.
borrow.use: Share a pot with someone, and a pick a sauce poll.

borrow.idea: Warm playful voice, schedule post pinned, pre order rhythm that sets expectations.
borrow.use: Pinned post with the 2 day lead time for premium items.

Approximate with one warm side lamp instead.

avoid.idea: Posts with no price and no order path, and a capped 20 orders a day story.
avoid.why: Merlin's wins on a clear direct order line and casual prices.

avoid.idea: High energy volume and event posts.
avoid.why: Competes on Affordable Comfort at volume. Merlin's stays Premium Ingredients, comfortable price.

avoid.idea: Grab only calls to action and copy that compares to other platforms.
avoid.why: Merlin's sells direct plus Grab. Never attack or compare with Grab.

avoid.idea: Emoji only or tag only captions.

style.visual: Warm, dark and glossy. Top down pot macros in steel pots, amber sauce, one side lamp. Best reel (6,981 views, median 222) was one unbroken 16 second macro with one text label. Gaps: most reels have no hook text, none end on a finished dish reveal.
style.context: Slow cooking as craft. The sofritto series (Hour 1, only 7 hours to go; aromatics merging; the trinity is complete) is a real series. Bio promise: Homemade flavours, done properly. Casual prices.
style.copy: Sensory hook, sharp invitation, standard footer. Warm, friendly and fun, led by appetite: make people hungry and make them smile. Short, punchy and a little cheeky, never quiet or flat. English only. Older captions end with DM or GrabFood link in bio, which is superseded by the order app link. Rules: slash prices only, no percentages.

proposals.title: Lamb shank with orzo (live)
proposals.hook: Soft orzo. Slow braised lamb. One very good gravy.
proposals.visual: Reel of the plated lamb shank on soft orzo, cover text "BRAISED LAMB SHANK", one spoon lift. Posted 17/11 after the launch photo on 15/11. Crop 4:5 for the grid cover.
proposals.caption: Soft orzo. Slow braised lamb. One very good gravy. 🥄 Fair warning: you will want a spoon for that gravy, and possibly a second shank. It braises for hours until it slides off the bone. Dig in.
proposals.why: Live on Instagram. The launch photo went up on 15/11 and this reel on 17/11, so the lamb shank launched with two posts.
proposals.borrow: @jose.kallioinen title card, @bshnuez dish name plus components

proposals.title: Drinks that go with your meal
proposals.visual: Top down on a dark table, the pot dish in the middle, three cold soft drinks around it (sparkling lemon, ginger beer, cloudy lemonade). One side lamp. Cover text "Pick a sidekick". No wine bottle or label in frame.
proposals.caption: Dinner needs a sidekick. Sparkling lemon, ginger beer, cloudy lemonade and more, all ready to go with your pot. Pick your pairing when you order. 😉
proposals.why: Shows the drinks range so people add one to every order. Keeps the post about the whole range and leaves alcohol out of the caption and the picture, because Thai law restricts advertising it.
proposals.avoid: No wine or alcohol names, bottles or labels, no price in the caption

proposals.title: Red Wine Beef Stew, cooler evenings
proposals.visual: Top down on the stew bowl, one side lamp, dark table. Dish name and components only on the cover.
proposals.caption: Cooler evenings called. Red Wine Beef Stew answered. Tender beef, red wine, carrot and a gravy that coats the spoon. Gathering around the table this Thursday? Bring the warmth. Order 2 days ahead.
proposals.why: A cosy, appetite first post for the cooler weather. It posts on Monday 23/11, three days before the US holiday on Thursday 26/11, so anyone gathering that day can still order in time. A nod to what customers need, never a Merlin's occasion.
proposals.avoid: No hard sell, no price in the caption

proposals.title: This is how it arrives
proposals.visual: Reference: @rhoifood bowl held above the branded bag. A hand holds a bowl of Red Wine Beef Stew just above your closed bag, your sticker facing the camera. Dark, moody backdrop, one side lamp, the bag lower third, the bowl catching the light. Hand only, no face. Crop 4:5.
proposals.caption: Plot twist: this is what dinner looks like when it arrives. Red Wine Beef Stew, slow cooked for hours, packed up and on its way to your door.
proposals.why: People order food they cannot see, so showing the bag and the bowl answers "what will I get" before a first order. The sticker on every package builds familiarity. The look comes from your @rhoifood reference.
proposals.borrow: @rhoifood bowl above the bag, one sticker as the brand mark
proposals.avoid: No platform logos on the bag in the shot, no comparisons

proposals.title: Why we brown first, plus we close 06/12
proposals.visual: Close on meat hitting the oil, then the dark crust lifting with water. Cover text "Brown first". Two clips of 4s, one reveal of 4s.
proposals.caption: Brown first. Always. That dark crust on the pan is where the flavour lives, so every bit goes back into the braise. We do not do shortcuts. We close from 06/12 to 11/12, so order and stock up on your favourites by Fri 04/12, or schedule an order for when we are back on Mon 14/12.
proposals.why: Moved from 07/12 to the week before the 06/12 to 11/12 closure, so a technique post also tells people to order and stock up. Shows technique, which supports the price, and it works for any dish.
proposals.avoid: Share the idea, not the full recipe

proposals.title: A pot for dad (Father's Day, 05/12)
proposals.visual: Slide 1: a pot and two bowls. Slide 2: the pot being lifted. Slide 3: dish name with "serves 2". Warm lamp, dark table. Post 02/12, two days before the last order day Fri 04/12.
proposals.caption: Father's Day dinner, sorted. Red Wine Beef Stew, Tuscan Pork Braise or the new Slow Braised Lamb Shank, slow cooked for hours and delivered to your door. Dad just has to show up hungry. Last day to order is Fri 04/12 because we close from 06/12 to 11/12, so order now or schedule one for when we are back on Mon 14/12.
proposals.why: Father's Day on 05/12 is a Thai holiday, so it speaks to the Thai audience. It also lands in the closure week, so the post carries the last order day.

proposals.title: Open the bag
proposals.hook: Everything that comes in the bag.
proposals.visual: Reference: @rhoifood opened container with sauces in small pots and a tied spoon. Slide 1: the closed bag with your sticker. Slide 2: flat lay from above of exactly what comes in an order, container open, sides, spoon, anything you tuck in. Slide 3: close on the sticker or lid label. Warm grey or cream backdrop, hard side light. Shoot only what really goes in the bag.
proposals.caption: Open the bag. A slow cooked dish, everything that comes with it, and a little care on top. Unwrapping dinner is half the fun. We are closed until Mon 14/12, so schedule your order now and we will deliver once we are back.
proposals.why: Moved from 14/12 to 07/12, 11 days after the first arrival post. Shoot it before you leave. It goes out while the shop is closed, so the call is to schedule an order.
proposals.avoid: Do not show anything that is not in a real order

proposals.title: Noir Ragu, the pot lift
proposals.visual: One continuous macro of Noir Ragu in the pot, a spoon lift, the sauce falling slowly. Cover text "Worth every hour". End on the plated pasta.
proposals.caption: Noir Ragu. Dark, deep and slow, and worth every hour. One spoon and you will understand. We are back Mon 14/12, so schedule your order now.
proposals.why: A payoff post that goes out while the shop is closed (06/12 to 11/12), so the call is to schedule an order for 14/12. Noir Ragu is a top 3 seller. Shoot it before you leave.
proposals.avoid: Do not reuse an earlier shot

proposals.title: The 8 hour sofritto
proposals.visual: Close on the sofritto in the pot, onion, carrot and celery melting into amber. Cover text "Hour 8 of 8". Finish on a wooden spoon lift. Crop 4:5 for the grid cover.
proposals.caption: Eight hours. Onion, carrot and celery, melting into amber. This is the base of every sauce we make, and yes, it smells as good as it looks. We are back today, and Christmas ordering is open.
proposals.why: Hour by hour post on the day the shop reopens (Mon 14/12), and it opens the Christmas ordering run. It comes from your sofritto series.
proposals.avoid: No cuts faster than every 3 seconds

proposals.title: Christmas table, we close 26/12
proposals.visual: Lamb shank or beef stew plated with rosemary and a candle, shot at 45 degrees. Cover text "Last order Fri 25/12".
proposals.caption: A slow pot for the Christmas table. Slow Braised Lamb Shank or Red Wine Beef Stew, cooked for hours so you can enjoy the day. We close from Sat 26/12 and are back Mon 04/01, so order ahead now or schedule your Christmas order.
proposals.why: Christmas is the real European moment for Merlin's. Moved from 12/12 to 16/12 so it starts the order push ahead of the 26/12 closure.
proposals.avoid: Do not promise a delivery date the order page cannot take. Scheduled orders deliver once the shop reopens

proposals.title: Lamb shank for the Christmas table
proposals.visual: Slow Braised Lamb Shank on soft orzo with a sprig of rosemary and a candle, shot at 45 degrees on a dark table, one side lamp. Cover text "Closing 26/12". Crop 4:5.
proposals.caption: The Christmas table centrepiece, sorted. Slow Braised Lamb Shank on soft orzo, with a gravy made for spooning. We close Sat 26/12 and are back Mon 04/01, so order and stock up now, or schedule your order for when we reopen.
proposals.why: Order push in the week before the 26/12 closure. Names one hero dish and tells people to order and stock up.
proposals.borrow: @jose.kallioinen title card, @bshnuez dish name plus components
proposals.avoid: No price, no stock scarcity lines, no delivery date before 04/01

proposals.title: Christmas table payoff, last orders
proposals.visual: One continuous macro of the lamb shank gravy, a spoon lift, the sauce falling slowly. Cover text "Last order Fri 25/12". End on the plated shank.
proposals.caption: Slow braised for hours, ready for your table. Last day to order is Fri 25/12, then we are closed until Mon 04/01. Order now, or schedule your order and we will deliver once we are back.
proposals.why: Second order push in the closure week. A last order day is a true deadline, so it gives people a reason to decide now.
proposals.avoid: No cuts faster than every 3 seconds, no delivery date before 04/01

proposals.title: First dish back
proposals.hook: Pick one. We cook it first.
proposals.visual: Two pots side by side from above. Story poll sticker added in the app. Reveal the winner in a Stories reply.
proposals.caption: We are closed until Mon 04/01, so you get to pick our first dish back. Spicy Rosso or Noir Ragu? Vote in Stories and the winner goes in the pot first. Schedule your order now and we will deliver once we reopen.
proposals.why: Moved from 05/12 to 28/12. It goes out while the shop is closed, gives people something to do, and the votes tell you what to cook first. Keep it to one a month.
proposals.avoid: No more than one game post a month

proposals.title: New Year, back 04/01
proposals.visual: A pot on a dark table, warm side lamp, soft focus string lights behind. Cover text "Back Mon 04/01". Crop 4:5.
proposals.caption: Happy New Year from our kitchen. Thank you for eating with us this year. We are back Mon 04/01, and you can schedule your first order of 2027 right now.
proposals.why: A thank you and a reminder while the shop is closed (26/12 to 03/01). New Year is a Thai and European occasion.

story.headline: Six pillars, one job each. Two closures, two order pushes.

points.title: Why this mix
points.body: Every pillar comes from something that already worked for you or a competitor. Open Pillars to see the source.

points.title: Who it is for
points.body: Thai 60 / Expat 40. Occasions follow the Thai and European calendars.

points.title: Check before shooting
points.body: The shop is closed 06/12 to 11/12 and 26/12 to 03/01. Posts in the week before each ask people to order and stock up, or schedule an order. Shoot the 07/12, 09/12 and 28/12 posts before you leave.

cadence: New proposals arrive every Sunday night for the week ahead.

pillars.name: Hour by hour
pillars.job: Shows the craft and the hours behind the price.
pillars.from: Your sofritto series (Hour 1, only 7 hours to go). @solsnack and @notorious_foodie run numbered series.

pillars.name: Worth the wait
pillars.job: The payoff shot that makes people hungry.
pillars.from: Your best reel: one unbroken macro, 6,981 views against a median of 222.

pillars.name: Name the dish
pillars.job: Introduces a dish and its parts, with one mood line.
pillars.from: @jose.kallioinen title card, @bshnuez dish name plus components caption.

pillars.name: Occasions
pillars.job: Gives people a reason to order now.
pillars.from: BOH dates (Loy Krathong, Father's Day 05/12, Christmas) and @hangrybeefnoodle occasion hooks. Thai and European moments.

pillars.name: Play
pillars.job: Gets people to do something, and shows what they want.
pillars.from: @hangrybeefnoodle game posts. Votes are customer research and a community ritual. One a month.

pillars.name: How it arrives
pillars.job: Shows what the customer receives, so a first order feels safe and the brand is known before the box is opened.
pillars.from: Your @rhoifood reference: the bowl held above the branded bag on a dark backdrop, the labelled container with sauces in small pots and a tied spoon, one sticker on every package. Borrow the look, not the results (the reference posts have 5 to 6 likes). Also the Grab bag thank you card idea.
